The second lesson in this fixture module exists so the reader's "previous" and "next" links have
something real to point at.

A line-by-line trace shows the program's variables, its call stack and its output as it runs,
one step at a time. The example below sums a list of numbers with a loop, then computes a small
factorial recursively:
